newsitem.title: USA: US LPGs mixed, butane down partly on iso spread.
newsitem.headline: US LPGs mixed, butane down partly on iso spread.

text.p: U.S. spot liquefied petroleum gas prices were mixed in quiet activity on Thurday as normal butane prices fell slightly in the U.S. Gulf and Conway, Kansas.

Normal butane in the USG hub of Mont Belvieu, Texas, fell about a quarter cent to 39.75/40.25 cents a gallon. Traders said the continued price drop reflects efforts by a major LPG producer to reduce the price of normal butane in order to widen the spread with isobutane.

Conway, Kansas, material fell to 37.00/37.75 cents. The shut down of some isomerization units, which typically happens when there is a weak spread between normal butane and isobutane prices, caused the slight drop, one trader said.
On propane, values were slightly stronger in Belvieu at 35.00/35.25 cents. One dealer said Warren bought a 135,000-barrel parcel at 35.25 cent, which accounted for the price rise.
Material remained steady in Conway at 34.00/34.25 cents.
Ethane mix deals were done in Belvieu 18.75 cents.
-- Tim Gardner, New York Oil Desk +1 212 859 1632 --
